repair.summary: Remove Vite, @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa. scripts/build.mjs runs the pipeline Vite 8 ran on the already-locked engines: rolldown 1.2.14 (oxc JSX automatic runtime and minifier, Vite's app output options), lightningcss 1.33.0 with Vite's es2020 CSS targets, hashed index.html tags, public/ copy, the same manifest, and sw/sw.js bundled with workbox-core/workbox-precaching 7.4.1 into one classic sw.js with a generated precache list.

lock.version_changes: none for retained packages; @rolldown/pluginutils is pinned by override to rolldown's previously locked 1.0.1 (npm would otherwise choose 1.1.1, published 2026-11-13, under two weeks old)

guards_added: build refuses any asset name the agent's pre-login policy would not serve
build refuses url()/@import in the stylesheet (no CSS asset pipeline)
build refuses more than one JavaScript chunk or stylesheet, a missing dev entry tag, and emptying any directory other than agent/wwwroot or dist
coordinates.test.ts now checks skipWaiting()/clientsClaim() in the worker source and the committed sw.js instead of vite.config.ts text
repair.dev_server: npm run dev / preview use scripts/dev.mjs: rebuild on change, proxy /api and /ws with Host and Origin rewritten to MO_AGENT; no hot module replacement.

equivalence.css: byte-identical to the Vite output (38940 bytes)

equivalence.workbox_runtime: same embedded versions (core/precaching/routing/strategies 7.4.0 markers), now inside sw.js instead of workbox-0bb07689.js
equivalence.javascript: same rolldown engine; differs by Vite's 670-byte modulepreload polyfill (single chunk, unused) and minor declaration grouping
